cards.front: Three-quarters of adhesive small bowel obstructions after appendicectomy present more than [___] after the operation.
cards.context:
Colicky pain, bilious vomiting and distension after recovery from abdominal surgery mean mechanical obstruction, most often from adhesions.

Start with nasogastric decompression and IV fluids; operate if it does not settle. Postoperative intussusception, which is rare, comes earlier: usually within 2 weeks.
